utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Sam, don't forget the repair drive is this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center! Need any help spreading the word?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks for the reminder, Vik! I could definitely use help putting up flyers around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can help with the flyers! And just to repeat, it's this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, I was thinking folks might need a drill or a saw for the projects. I can bring those on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good. Do you want me to make a sign-up sheet for borrowing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, that would be perfect, Rey! A sign-up sheet sounds like a great idea to keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Eli, the repair drive is today. Want to help me check what supplies we've got left?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Today? I didn't realize it was scheduled. Let me check my notes again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, it snuck up on me too. Let's head to the shed and see what we're working with.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I keep forgetting about that.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yeah, easy to forget. We should use the side entrance for pickup to avoid the delay.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Side entrance, huh? That's smart. I'll try to remember that... but you might have to remind me on the day.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Uli, just to confirm, the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, Saturday at 9 at the Elm Street center. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, 9 AM at Elm Street. I'll bring my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? I'm helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, Jules, I've heard a bit about it. Sounds like a good idea—I'll try to make it out there on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, Dane! It'll be good to have you there. If you know anyone else who might be interested, feel free to bring them along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Mina, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? I think it's at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It starts at 9 AM, from what I've heard.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hi Opal, I'm glad we're planning the repair drive for Saturday. We need to make sure everyone knows what tools they're bringing and when they'll get them back.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is at the community center on Elm Street, starting at 9 AM this Saturday. I've got it marked on my map. What tools are we short on?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We're especially short on sewing machines and soldering irons. Could you help spread the word to ask neighbors to lend those?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, I'm still not convinced. What makes you think this drive is on the level?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I don't know much, just that people are talking about it. Noah mentioned seeing a flyer, so I figured it must be legit.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A flyer? Those could be posted by anyone. Did Noah actually talk to the organizers?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Bo, did you know the repair drive is actually happening today? I'm heading over to drop off my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, I thought it was Saturday. But okay, I'll grab my toolbox and meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great! I'll meet you by the community center entrance. They've got a station set up for small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Leo, are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'll be there. Need me to bring any specific tools?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great! Maybe bring a basic toolkit with screwdrivers, a hammer, and some pliers. I think we'll have a variety of fixes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo! And Mara, I checked with the city—turns out the road closure is only on Saturday, and our drive is Sunday, so no worries. We'll have a clear route.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, that's a relief! So we can proceed without worrying about school pickup then. Count me in for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Mara! We'll start at 9 AM at the community center. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Nell, have you heard about the repair drive? It might affect the school pickup schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I've heard bits about it, but I'm not sure about the schedule. Does anyone have the full details?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I've heard it's from 2 to 4 PM, so pickup at 3 will be delayed. Maybe we can use the side entrance to avoid the traffic.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Pia! The repair drive is this Sunday at the community center. Can I count on you to help out?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, it's Saturday, not Sunday. Can you double-check the flyer?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, sorry for the confusion! It was moved from Saturday to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You really think this repair drive is on the up-and-up? I've seen too many scams around here.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I think it's legit. I've been hearing good things from folks around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good things from who? Can you name one person who actually benefited from this drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, right. Saturday. I'll try to be there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, it's at 9 AM at the community center. Hope to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: 9 AM, Elm Street. Got it. I have a lot on my mind, but I'll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? Need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I heard about it! I'll be there to help out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, glad you're on board! Let me know if you want to work on a specific project or just generally assist.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Alright, let's start counting what we've got. Anyone want to give me a hand?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help count. What's the tally so far?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Leo! So far we've got 15 rolls of duct tape and 10 toolkits. Need you to check the screws and nails pile.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I've heard! It's at the community center on Elm Street, right? I've already marked it on my map.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great. What time does it start, and what are we fixing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Starts at 9 AM this weekend. Bring any broken items you'd like help fixing!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Rey! Are we still on for the repair drive? I keep forgetting when it is.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, it's this Saturday. Want me to remind you again?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, yes please! And what time does it start again?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Jules, I've got some tools I could lend for the repair drive if you need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's great, Gus! I'll let Vik know you have tools to lend. Are you planning to come by on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I'll be there. Just let me know what tools you need most and I'll bring 'em along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh? The repair drive? Oh, right, that's today?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No, it's this Saturday from 2 to 4 on Elm Street. We might need to plan around the road closure near the school.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Saturday, right. Elm Street... got it. I'll try to remember that.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I still don't have the schedule for the repair drive, but I'll make sure to share it once I find out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries, Eli! The drive is Saturday at 9 AM at the community center on Elm Street. Hope you can join us!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, thanks Quinn! That's perfect—I'll put it in my planner and see you there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Ah, right, Saturday at the community center. I'll try to swing by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good. Let me know if you need any details.
